title: The Blue Side of Hope
story:
There is a side of j-hope that is quieter, more nostalgic, and more introspective. One of the best ways to discover it is through a song called "Blue Side."

The story of this song began long before its release. j-hope revealed that he had started working on it around 2015, after "1 VERSE." At the time, he was drawn to the feeling of blue: the sky, the wind, and the memories connected to them.

When "Blue Side" appeared as the outro of his first mixtape, HOPE WORLD, in March 2018, it was a short instrumental track. During a live broadcast celebrating the mixtape's release, he explained that listening to it brought back memories of his younger self, a time when he knew less about the world and simply followed his feelings. He had chosen it as the outro because it felt like a beautiful way to close the album.

But the song stayed with him. Three years later, on March 2, 2021, the third anniversary of HOPE WORLD, j-hope released a complete version of "Blue Side," now with lyrics and an expanded melody.

In a message to fans, he explained that nostalgia for his younger days had inspired him to finally finish the song. He sometimes missed the innocent boy who used to write down his thoughts freely, without overthinking them. Although he knew he could never return to that time, he wanted to create a blue place where he could find comfort, rest, and calm.

The full version was also a way of showing his musical growth. j-hope explained that he had not been able to complete the song earlier because its emotions and musical ideas were difficult for him to handle at the time. Years later, he finally felt ready to understand and express them.

This is what makes "Blue Side" so special. It reminds us that behind the bright smile, boundless energy, and hopeful image, there is also an artist who looks back, feels nostalgic, and sometimes needs a quiet place to breathe.

Hope doesn't always have to be loud or bright. Sometimes, it is blue.
surpriseDescription: A softer, more emotional moment from an unforgettable festival stage. Experience “Blue Side (Outro)” performed by j-hope at Lollapalooza Chicago.

challenge.question: Why did j-hope decide to complete and release the full version of "Blue Side" in 2021?
options: He wanted to remake it as a dance track for a live performance.
Nostalgia for his younger self inspired him, and he wanted to create a comforting place through music.
He had originally planned to release it as the title track of HOPE WORLD.
challenge.answer: Nostalgia for his younger self inspired him, and he wanted to create a comforting place through music.
challenge.explanation: j-hope said that he sometimes missed the innocent days when he freely wrote down his feelings. He wanted "Blue Side" to become a comforting place where he could calm himself and revisit those memories.
